description: We are a team of 12th-grade students from Palu, Central Sulawesi. This is our very first time participating in the NASA Space Apps Challenge hackathon! Our team is filled with curious minds, passionate storytellers, visual artists, and dreamers who have a unique talent for interpreting their imagination and turning it into reality. Through this project, we want to prove that geographical boundaries and age are no limits when it comes to creating something meaningful for space exploration.
